purpose.title: 2. Website purpose
purpose.content: This website aims to provide information about digital automation, web development and artificial intelligence services offered by AMG Digital Engineering to small and medium businesses in Mallorca.

terms.title: 3. Terms of use
terms.content: The user agrees to use the content and services appropriately and not to engage in any unlawful activities or activities contrary to good faith.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.content: The data controller for personal data collected on this website is Antonio Más Gutiérrez (AMG Digital Engineering).

dataCollected.title: 2. Data collected
dataCollected.content: We collect: name and surname, email address, phone number, and billing information when services are contracted.

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of processing
purpose.content: Data is processed for: managing quote requests, providing contracted services, sending commercial communications (with prior consent), and complying with legal obligations.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal basis
legalBasis.content: The legal basis for data processing is: execution of a service contract, consent of the data subject, and compliance with legal obligations.

rights.title: 5. Data subject rights
rights.content: Users may exercise their rights of access, rectification, deletion, restriction, portability and objection by emailing hola@amg.cat.

security.title: 6. Security measures
security.content: We apply appropriate technical and organisational security measures to protect personal data, including AES-256 encryption for sensitive data and role-based access control.

object.title: 1. Purpose
object.content: These Terms of Service govern the contracting of digital automation, web development and artificial intelligence services offered by AMG Digital Engineering.

services.title: 2. Services
services.content: AMG offers: website development, n8n process automation, AI chatbots, WhatsApp Business integration, domain and SSL management, and digital consulting.

pricing.title: 3. Pricing and billing
pricing.content: Prices are set according to the agreed budget with the client. Billing is monthly or according to the schedule agreed in the contract.

obligations.title: 4. Client obligations
obligations.content: The client agrees to provide the necessary information for service delivery, pay invoices within the agreed period, and not misuse the contracted services.
